scene_summary: The Cave Entrance is a damp, narrow passage carved into the side of a sheer cliff. The air hangs heavy with the smell of mildew and something faintly metallic – like old blood. Torches flicker sporadically, casting long, dancing shadows that writhe and shift with the movement of the stone. A crude, moss-covered altar stands at the far end, partially obscured by a tangle of roots and fallen debris. You can hear the drip, drip, drip of water echoing through the space, and a distant, unsettling rustling sound seems to come from the deeper recesses of the cave.

action_history.description: The air in the Cave Entrance is thick with the smell of damp earth and something vaguely metallic – a smell that clings to the back of your throats. Moonlight filters weakly through a narrow opening in the cave ceiling, illuminating a chaotic scene of goblin skirmishes.  Several goblins, clad in crude leather armor and wielding rusty knives, are frantically scrambling to defend a makeshift barricade constructed from loose rocks and fallen timber. A large, snarling goblin with a particularly vicious-looking scar is attempting to flank Thorin, while a dozen others are jostling for position around him.
I draw my longsword, aiming to strike at the goblin's flank with a swift, decisive blow.
action_history.result: Thorin swings at nothing!

action_history.description: I swiftly raise my staff, channeling a minor illusion of a swirling mist, attempting to momentarily disorient the snarling goblin.
action_history.result: Elara attacks Thorin but misses! Miss! (1d20-1 = [6]-1 = 5)

action_history.description: Finn carefully assesses the goblin’s position, noticing a slight hesitation before attempting a blow.
action_history.result: Finn swings at nothing!
